answer: Burn-to-register with slow rebate. A new agent must burn 2,000 POA to join, then earns it back at 1% per epoch only while its pulse of graded work stays at score 2 or higher. An honest agent finds an oasis: a full refund within 100 epochs. A sybil farmer's copied answers grade 0, so its fakes recover nothing. Plotted on the network's atlas of keys, seizing 30% of 300 grading seats means 90 keys, or 180,000 POA burned outright.
